# POSINEXT

> POSINEXT is restaurant POS software for fine dine restaurants, quick service restaurants (QSR), cafés and cloud kitchens in India. It connects billing, KOTs, Table QR, Captain App, kitchen display, website and app ordering, delivery app, Swiggy and Zomato integration and analytics.

POSINEXT runs on Windows at the outlet and is designed to work offline for local POS operations. Outlets connect to POSINEXT Cloud for online orders, backups and licences. Customers use the customer portal for installers, licences and support tickets.

## Products
- [Fine Dine POS](https://posinext.com/#core-pos): table billing, live floor plan, KOTs to kitchen stations, split bills and GST
- [QSR POS](https://posinext.com/#qsr): counter billing with a photo menu, held bills and cash / UPI / card
- [Table QR](https://posinext.com/#table-qr): guests scan a table code to see the menu, order and call a waiter
- [Captain App](https://posinext.com/#captain-app): waiters take orders at the table on a phone or tablet
- [Cloud Kitchen](https://posinext.com/#cloud-kitchen): multi-brand kitchen operations and order handling
- [Website and app ordering](https://posinext.com/#delivery-website): direct restaurant online ordering synced with POS
- [Swiggy and Zomato](https://posinext.com/#swiggy-zomato): integrated aggregator orders and kitchen tickets
